title: Colonel Alexander's precognitive sentient phenomenon at Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: someone like Colonel Alexander to formulate what he called precognitive sentient phenomena.

plain: At Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, an Army colonel named Alexander came up with what he called precognitive sentient phenomena: something there that seems aware and seems to know in advance what the investigators will do. The philosopher Jason Jorjani passes on Alexander's idea, pointing to a book called Closer Encounters.
